## Translation Tool
**Purpose:** validate, normalize and cache translations without altering the original text.
**Input:** POST /webhook/pulse/translate, max 4000 chars.
**Output:** originalText, translatedText, sourceLanguage, targetLanguage, provider.
**Credentials:** optional `PULSE Google Translation`; never expose its key to React.
**Dependencies:** provider result may be injected after a credentialed HTTP node.
**Failure path:** same-language text passes through; otherwise returns TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE.

parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const originalText=String(body.text??'').slice(0,4000);const sourceLanguage=String(body.sourceLanguage??'auto').slice(0,8);const targetLanguage=String(body.targetLanguage??'').slice(0,8);const allowed=new Set(['auto','es','en','fr','pt','de']);if(!originalText.trim()||!allowed.has(sourceLanguage)||!allowed.has(targetLanguage)||targetLanguage==='auto')return[{json:{ok:false,error:{code:'INVALID_PAYLOAD',message:'Solicitud de traducción inválida.'}}}];const supplied=typeof body.translatedText==='string'?body.translatedText.slice(0,8000):null;const same=sourceLanguage===targetLanguage;const translatedText=same?originalText:supplied;if(!translatedText)return[{json:{ok:false,error:{code:'TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE',message:'El proveedor de traducción no está configurado.'},originalText,sourceLanguage,targetLanguage}}];return[{json:{ok:true,translation:translatedText,originalText,translatedText,sourceLanguage,targetLanguage,provider:same?'passthrough':'google_translation',cacheKey:`${sourceLanguage}:${targetLanguage}:${originalText.length}`,generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];
